# `foxglove recordings transfer`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](recordings.md)

```text
Request transfer of a recording from its Edge Site to its configured Primary Site

Usage: foxglove recordings transfer [OPTIONS] <RECORDING_ID>

Arguments:
  <RECORDING_ID>


Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
```
